name: manual_64789c
claim: Cross-repository pointer checks must use the actual paired immutable peer revision when branches have different names. Keep one canonical generator, support linked worktrees, and refuse explicit-peer checkout failure instead of falling back to unrelated main. Separate publish order from the approved merge order.

decisions.notes: Orama477 cf87c340 explicitly pins PT481 66c4af6d; wrapper regression 8ddd9144 proves linked-worktree checks and drift refusal. Two-line formatting was operator-allowed, not a reason to hand-edit pointers.
